summary: Use unified_gliner_protocol (original OCR, document-level micro-F1, one batch_extract per doc) for all v0.1.0 comparisons. Earlier DSRE GLiNER numbers are episode-level and not comparable to F1≈0.42.

root_causes: DSRE scores one gold field per episode (first GLiNER span only), not document-level canonical_gt.
DSRE rebuilds text from deduplicated candidate lines and truncates to 3500 chars, not full OCR lines.
DSRE infers once per NPZ doc_id (may differ from HF test doc count); latency measured inside heavy DSRE process.
